name: Robot Cell Entry
label: SYNTHETIC — a scripted expert at skill 0.85 with action noise standing in for a person; no learner episode is in this set

safePractice.text: Entered the cell before it was stopped and locked out.
Finished without testing the e-stop first.
Tried to lock out before the robot was stopped.
Entered without a try-start check for zero energy.
Tried to restart while a lock was still on.
Left without removing your own lock and restarting the cell.

sample.note: 3 of 40 demonstrations, written in the LeRobot- and RLDS-style layouts (lerobot/, rlds/); the full set is reproduced by seed

notThis: not recorded from any person: every episode is generated by a scripted policy
not a measurement of any physical robot, site or machine; the scenario is procedural
not a certification of safe practice; the rules are this engine's, not a standards body's
not large: the set is a few thousand steps on a small discrete task and does not generalise beyond it
